preservation.method: Only generated new pigment selected and placed on bare central rock; all other RGB pixels retained.

visual_review.status: Worker inspected finished full-size PNG and encoded JPEG
observations: Both ancestral wide-mouth heavy-lidded Pepe figures remain unchanged.
The sole visible inherited hand retains five digits: four fingers and one thumb. No new hands or handprints.
Added only a small charcoal bowl with two red ochre pebbles between two yellow-ochre standing stones.
No letters, numbers, captions, logos, signatures, watermarks, border or frame observed.
Original square dimensions, rock, cracks, light and framing retained; all RGB pixels outside the bare-rock patch are identical.
limitations: Worker review is not independent human approval.
Small strokes are less distinct in the JPEG.
Inherited rock has photographic appearance; preserving it retains that appearance.
Historical Ethereum ZTO metadata reused; no live balance query.
Minimum-first policy is explicit; only positive weights receive discretionary units.
RewardBounds has its own schema and complete-recomputation verifier; RewardSplit-specific audit/batch/merge tools do not accept it.
Largest-remainder rounding can reduce an individual share as the total budget rises.
Unsigned reports do not establish identity, entitlement, available funds, authorization or payment.
Detailed reports can hit the 256-KiB output bound before 1000 contributors.
image_method: Built-in imagegen created the mark; only its new pigment was composited over original bare rock. Existing local PNG and JPEG helpers encoded outputs.
